answers.assumption_check: Assumes the journal holds one newest entry per path (plus a day trail, test_the_journal_keeps_the_newest_entry_per_path_and_a_day_trail.py), so a staged journal can be composed per path: HEAD's entry for a path the commit does not carry, the working entry for one it does. Assumes a commit's journal only has to explain the commit's own records; the working-tree journal keeps every line, so the commit that later carries the record carries its line. Assumes check_staged sees the commit's index through GIT_INDEX_FILE, as check_shared_index already reads it.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: where the journal is staged (check_staged's last lines in cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py); how to read the commit's index (GIT_INDEX_FILE, as check_shared_index and _staged do); how to write an index blob without touching the file (git hash-object -w --stdin, then git update-index --cacheinfo 100644,<sha>,.artifact-journal.jsonl under the same GIT_INDEX_FILE); what HEAD's journal is (git show HEAD:.artifact-journal.jsonl, empty when absent); how the day trail ties to a path (read the journal-format proof named in assumption_check); and the harness (cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_a_commit_takes_only_the_paths_its_author_names.py: a scratch CairnCommons repo, the real hook via install-hook, CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS). Tooth 2's crash is injected by an env-named fault in the tester run, or by a fake tester module on PYTHONPATH; the builder picks the one that keeps cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py unchanged. All carried in decisions.

(1) A journaled record A left unstaged and a `git commit -- B`: the committed journal's entry for A is HEAD's (or absent if HEAD had none), B's is the working one. (2) The measured row: a pre-commit reseal forced to raise OSError(ENOSPC) after it has sealed one proof, under `git commit -- <source>`: the commit lands, the run says COULD NOT RUN, and for every path in the committed journal the committed blob hashes to that entry's sha_after. (3) The working-tree journal is byte-identical before and after the check: only the index blob is composed.
